text: The Galois group Gal(𝔽_{pⁿ} / 𝔽_p) is:
choices: cyclic of order n, generated by the Frobenius map x ↦ xᵖ
trivial, since finite fields are rigid
explanation: Frobenius φ(x) = xᵖ fixes exactly 𝔽_p (the roots of xᵖ = x) and has order n on 𝔽_{pⁿ}, so ⟨φ⟩ realizes the full group of order [𝔽_{pⁿ}:𝔽_p] = n. Every extension of finite fields is Galois with cyclic group.
